type of breech presentation (complete or frank)
outcome: Neonatal morbidity (composite variable from Term Breech Trial)
Use of forceps for after-coming head
cohort: 495 women with singleton pregnancies at or after 37 weeks of gestation who underwent a trial of vaginal delivery for breech presentation
finding: Among women eligible for vaginal delivery, the type of breech presentation (complete or frank) did not significantly influence cesarean section rates or neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: The type of breech presentation (complete or frank) did not significantly influence cesarean section rates.
